meaning:
συν-πορεύομαι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;]
1. to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), Luk.7:11 14:25 24:15.
2. to come together: Mrk.10:1 (Plut., al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching…
Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
